text: Next, Soapy went into a cheap restaurant. <break time="0.8s" /> Where the food was plain. <break time="0.8s" /> And the plates were thick. <break time="0.8s" /> He ate beefsteak, pancakes, doughnuts, and pie. <break time="0.8s" /> And then he told the waiter. <break time="0.8s" /> That he had no money. <break time="0.8s" /> Now, call a policeman. <break time="0.8s" /> Said Soapy. <break time="0.8s" /> And do not keep a gentleman waiting. <break time="0.8s" /> Two waiters threw him out instead. <break time="0.8s" /> And he landed on his left ear. <break time="0.8s" /> On the hard sidewalk. <break time="0.8s" /> A policeman who stood nearby. <break time="0.8s" /> Only laughed. <break time="0.8s" /> And walked away down the street. <break time="0.8s" /> After walking five blocks. <break time="0.8s" /> Soapy found a young woman. <break time="0.8s" /> Looking at a shop window. <break time="0.8s" /> With a large policeman standing near her. <break time="0.8s" /> Soapy planned to bother her rudely. <break time="0.8s" /> Because he was sure. <break time="0.8s" /> That the policeman would arrest him for it. <break time="0.8s" /> He fixed his tie. <break time="0.8s" /> Coughed loudly. <break time="0.8s" /> And spoke to her boldly. <break time="0.8s" /> Glancing at the policeman again and again. <break time="0.8s" /> To his surprise. <break time="0.8s" /> The young woman happily took his arm. <break time="0.8s" /> And asked him to buy her. <break time="0.8s" /> Something to drink. <break time="0.8s" /> At the next corner. <break time="0.8s" /> Soapy shook off her arm and ran. <break time="0.8s" /> For it seemed. <break time="0.8s" /> That he was doomed to freedom.
